name: Physeerlia
description: Native Overseerr and Jellyseerr requests and discovery integration.
overview: Seamlessly integrates Overseerr and Jellyseerr requests, discovery, and media management directly into the Jellyfin web client with automatic zero-login SSO delegation and granular per-user permissions.
